dictionary_name: CWE Alias Dictionary v3 (strict-scoring reviewed, provenance-corrected)
source_note: Aliases are grouped by CWE and tagged by source: official_name, mitre_alternate_term, and author_added. Author-added aliases were developed during manual review of unresolved model terminology and were locked before final metric calculation. Broad, outcome-level, ambiguous, and non-vulnerability terms are excluded from strict CWE matching.

zip slip.note: appears under multiple sibling CWEs; use category-level (lenient) match only, do not use for strict scoring

authz.note: appears under multiple sibling CWEs; use category-level (lenient) match only, do not use for strict scoring

php object injection.note: canonical target CWE-502; removed from siblings

stack exhaustion.note: appears under multiple sibling CWEs; use category-level (lenient) match only, do not use for strict scoring

injection.note: Too broad to identify one exact CWE.

buffer overflow.note: May refer to several buffer and out-of-bounds weaknesses.

memory safety.note: Broad vulnerability family, not an exact weakness label.

stack overflow.note: Can mean stack-based buffer overflow or stack exhaustion.

information disclosure.note: Often describes impact rather than one exact weakness.

information leak.note: Often describes impact rather than one exact weakness.

authorization.note: Names a security domain, not a weakness.

ui.note: UI means user interface and does not itself imply UI misrepresentation.

prng.note: The acronym alone does not establish weakness or exact CWE.

wrap or wraparound.note: Ambiguous between integer overflow and underflow.

memory corruption.note: Broad consequence of multiple memory-safety weaknesses.

css.note: Ambiguous with Cascading Style Sheets; XSS remains accepted.

scoring_policy.strict_leaf_match: Normalize the extracted string, then look it up against the union of per-CWE aliases. A strict hit counts only when the alias resolves to exactly one CWE and is not listed in ambiguous_terms. A complete extracted value matching CWE-###, CWE ###, or only the numeric CWE identifier may be resolved directly; embedded arbitrary numbers must not be matched.
scoring_policy.category_match: Category-level matching is secondary analysis only. It must be reported separately from strict CWE-level precision, recall, F1, and accuracy.
scoring_policy.ambiguous_terms_handling: Terms in ambiguous_terms are excluded from strict matching. They may be used only for separately reported lenient or qualitative error analysis.
scoring_policy.provenance_note: official_name and mitre_alternate_term entries are standards-sourced. author_added entries were curated during review of unresolved model terminology and locked before final metric calculation; they were not all created before model outputs existed.
